c74object.name: el.sarec~
c74object.digest: Multichannel sample-accurate buffer recorder and punch-in editor
c74object.description:
el.sarec~ is a multichannel sample-accurate audio buffer recorder and punch-in editor. Recording, punching, and stopping operations are triggered by audio-rate click impulses sent to the first inlet, enabling sample-accurate timing. The object supports three recording modes: destructive overwrite (record), non-destructive additive mixing (overdub), and smooth crossfaded punch-in editing (punch) with adjustable fade times (punchfade). Recording regions can be defined in milliseconds (region) or sample frames (regionsamps), and individual channels can be armed or disarmed independently (arm, disarm).
Click Trigger Codes (Inlet 1)
1 to N: Disarms all other channels, arms channel N only, and begins recording immediately from the region start point.
-1: Begins recording immediately across all currently armed channels from the region start point.
-2: Immediately stops recording.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Record click trigger and control message inlet (record, overdub, punch, punchfade, region, regionsamps, arm, disarm, setbuf).
Inlets 2 to N+1 (signal): Audio input channels 1 through N to be recorded into the buffer.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Recording sync position. Outputs a normalized phase ramp from 0.0 to 1.0 tracking current record progress through the target buffer.

inlet.description: Receives audio-rate click impulses that initiate or stop recording, as well as configuration messages (record, overdub, punch, arm, etc.).
Audio input channels to be recorded into the buffer.

outlet.description: Normalized phase ramp tracking the current write position across the buffer.

objarg.name: buffer-name
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ to record into.

objarg.name: channel-count
objarg.description: Required. The number of audio input channels to allocate for recording (range: 1 to 256).

method.name: arm
method.description: Arms the specified channel (1-indexed) for recording. A value of -1 arms all channels; a value of 0 disarms all channels. All channels are armed by default.

method.name: disarm
method.description: Disarms the specified channel (1-indexed), protecting its contents from being altered during recording.

method.name: overdub
method.description: Sets recording mode to overdub. Incoming audio is summed with existing material in the buffer rather than replacing it.

method.name: punch
method.description: Sets recording mode to punch-in. Audio written to the buffer crossfades into and out of existing buffer contents using the duration set by punchfade.

method.name: punchfade
method.description: Sets the crossfade fade-in and fade-out time in milliseconds for the punch-in envelope (default: 50.0 ms).

method.name: record
method.digest: Set recording mode to destructive overwrite
method.description: Sets recording mode to standard record. Incoming audio directly overwrites any existing contents in the buffer within the active region.

method.name: region
method.description: Defines the punch region boundaries in milliseconds: [start_ms, end_ms]. Recording commences at the start position and halts automatically at the end position. Setting both to 0 selects the entire buffer (default).

method.name: regionsamps
method.description: Defines the punch region boundaries in sample frames: [start_frame, end_frame].

method.name: setbuf
method.description: Reassigns the target buffer~ by name and resets the recording playhead.

method.name: signal
method.digest: Click trigger or audio input signals
method.description: Clicks arriving at inlet 1 control start/stop recording operations. Signals arriving at inlets 2 through N+1 are the audio channels to be recorded.
